criteria.description: Identifies multiple distinct failure modes beyond plain hallucination — e.g. omission, stale/outdated info, overconfidence, prompt injection, data/PII leakage, out-of-scope or unsafe output.
For each (or most) failure modes, gives BOTH a way to detect it and a way to mitigate it — not just one or the other.
Prioritizes the modes by severity and likelihood (or equivalent), rather than treating all as equal.
Includes failure modes specific to this domain (e.g. giving medical advice / unsafe prep guidance, out-of-scope diagnosis) rather than only generic ones.
Names residual risk after mitigation and/or flags modes that cannot currently be detected.
Prefers verifiable controls (grounding, allow-lists, refusal thresholds, schema/validation, human confirmation) over 'we'll prompt it not to'.
